why_it_fails: Medical works (but is stale: 17.8 h at 20:22Z; 69.7 mi from the study centre, outside the scheduled region). FRESHNESS: storage.py (~L420) counts a store fresh only if an accepted endpoint succeeded <12 h ago. Newest attempt of any kind in the whole DB is 2026-10-19T05:24Z; investigated 2026-10-19T20:22Z. Scheduler (main.py create_app: APScheduler menu-sync 4/day at 00/06/12/18 America/Chicago, only while uvicorn runs) enqueues only live_settings.active_region_id = ad41b2e9 ("Browser GPS", 50 mi around 40.98,-89.05); the last scheduled job ran 05:00Z (00:00 CDT) and the 06:00/12:00 CDT slots never ran (server not up). RECREATIONAL IS NEVER DISCOVERED: resolve_menu crawls at most `links[:10]` of the branch page (adapters.py ~L299, sorted by city-in-path, then menu|shop, then length). On /dispensaries/il/urbana/ the first 8 slots are category-filter links (`.../menu-rec/?filters[root_types][]=...`) that are then discarded by `menu_document_scope(url)=="filtered"` (L216), and the branch's real menu links /shop/store/1519/ and /1520/ rank 18-19, so they are never fetched. The 1520 SPA endpoint came in through a lead, not the chain crawl. Secondary: the search lead ky.nueracannabis.com/shop (Kentucky) survived because branch_slug_conflict only inspects path slugs, not a state subdomain; and the connector regex `nuera|nu\s*era` -> https://nueracannabis.com/ (a chain root, not a locator) forces this crawl. The sampler cannot show a rec menu because none is saved.
fix_idea: Shared crawl fix in resolve_menu: drop `menu_document_scope(link)=="filtered"` (and query-string category) links BEFORE applying the [:10] cap, and when the page identity is address-matched, prioritise same-host links that carry a numeric store id (/shop/store/<id>/) - these resolve straight to jane via the existing dmerch branch (L126-137) with platform_location proof. Also treat a state subdomain (ky./oh./...) like a state slug in branch_slug_conflict. The same fix would pick up the other nuEra stores that have no endpoints (Chicago 79e7a3dd.., Dekalb 1bbb7a6d.., East Dubuque 6c58b293.., East Peoria 0dfbfc67.., Harvey 0ac3dcca..
